title: Month of the Quote and the Active-Account Repayment Installments — School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The repayment plan for active accounts's installments follow the school year: one more (1) for a quote date in August, September, October or November, one fewer (a change of -1) for a quote date in March, April, May, June or July, and no change for a quote date in December, January or February. This governs repayment payments on every School Nutrition Services Meal Account.

| Month of the quote date | Change to the installments |
|---|---|
| August, September, October, November | one more |
| December, January, February | no change |
| March, April, May, June, July | one fewer (-1) |

Points of judgement: the month of the quote date alone decides the change, whatever the year; a quote date of November 30 still gives one more, and one of December 1 gives none.
